definition: [ חַרְצֻבָּה ] noun [feminine] bond, fetter, pang , only plural חַרְצֻבּוֺת ; — 1. construct רֶשַׁע ׳ ח Isa 58:6 bonds of wickedness i.e. imposed by wicked men (|| אֲגֻדּוֺת מוֺטָה ). 2. pangs (compare חֶבֶל , חֵבֶל ), absolute ׳ אֵין ח למותם Ps 73:4 they have no pangs (read ׳ לָ֑מוֺ תָּם וגו ). חַרְצַנִּים see sub. I. חרץ . above

BDB3164 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB3166

[חַרְצֻבָּה] noun [feminine] bond, fetter, pang, only plural חַרְצֻבּוֺת; —

1. construct רֶשַׁע ׳ח Isa 58:6 bonds of wickedness i.e. imposed by wicked men (|| אֲגֻדּוֺת מוֺטָה).
2. pangs (compare חֶבֶל, חֵבֶל), absolute ׳אֵין ח למותם Ps 73:4 they have no pangs (read ׳לָ֑מוֺ תָּם וגו).

חַרְצַנִּים see sub. I. חרץ. above
